title: Two Tankers and a Tugboat

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm, a shade lighter: markets rallied after the Democratic sweep and Brent slid near $94, while tankers burned in Hormuz, Russia's aid-site strike killed 40, and the last Wairarapa whales died. Ebola vaccine trials and a bigger Pantanal park offered small, real relief.
